name: Osobennaja sud'ba
source:
The protagonist is Semyon Persunov, a completely ordinary eleventh grader getting ready for school. However, a surprise awaits him there... A new girl named Miku has joined the class, and Semyon, more than anyone else, must help her figure out her new environment and everything else. But on the very first day she arrives, things do not go according to plan...

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2002371895]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主角是谢苗·佩尔苏诺夫（Semyon Persunov），一个正准备上学的普通十一年级学生。然而，一个惊喜在那里等待着他……一个名叫Miku的新女孩加入了班级，而Semyon比任何人都更需要帮助她了解新环境和其他一切。但她到达的第一天，事情并没有按计划进行……

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2002371895]Steam[/url]]
